name: Question 8
problem: John selected a pair of socks out of his drawer without looking in the drawer. He has $5$ pairs of black dress socks, $4$ pairs of brown dress socks, $10$ pairs of black sports socks, and $3$ pairs of white sport socks. What is the probability of selecting a pair of black socks or a pair of sports socks?
